title: [Bug][T2]: `gnmi/test_gnmi_configdb.py` fails on modular systems if supervisor is selected `duthost`
author: arista-nwolfe
body:
### Issue Description

`gnmi/test_gnmi_configdb.py` has a couple of tests which rely on ports existing on the `duthost`
TEST1 - `test_gnmi_configdb_incremental_01`
```
  File "/data/tests/gnmi/test_gnmi_configdb.py", line 57, in test_gnmi_configdb_incremental_01
    assert interface is not None, "Invalid interface"
AssertionError: Invalid interface
```
It's fetching the interface from `CONFIG_DB` of the `duthost`:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/gnmi/test_gnmi_configdb.py#L48
```
def get_interface_status(duthost, field, interface='Ethernet0'):
    cmds = 'sonic-db-cli CONFIG_DB hget "PORT|{}" {}'.format(interface, field)
```

TEST2 - `test_gnmi_configdb_full_01`
```
  File "/data/tests/gnmi/test_gnmi_configdb.py", line 117, in test_gnmi_configdb_full_01
    assert "PORT" in dic, "Failed to read running config"
AssertionError: Failed to read running config
```
It's getting the port data from `sonic-cfggen` on the `duthost`:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/gnmi/test_gnmi_configdb.py#L227
```
output = duthost.shell("sonic-cfggen -d --print-data")
assert (not output['rc']), "No output"
dic = json.loads(output["stdout"])
assert "PORT" in dic, "Failed to read running config"
```

The problem is the fixture used by these tests is `rand_one_dut_hostname` which includes the supervisor which won't have any ports on it in modular systems.

We could update the tests to instead use `rand_one_dut_front_end_hostname` but this will require updating all the `autouse=True` fixtures in `gnmi/conftest` and will therefor impact the other `gnmi` tests like `gnmi/test_gnmi.py` and `gnmi/test_gnmi_appldb.py`


### Results you see

`gnmi/test_gnmi_configdb.py` is being run on supervisor `duthost` but the test requires PORTs on the `duthost`

### Results you expected to see

`gnmi/test_gnmi_configdb.py` should likely only run against the LC `duthosts`

### Is it platform specific

generic

comments.author: arista-nwolfe
comments.body:
> Would it be better to roll a frontend node rather than skip the test?

We discussed this in the community meeting today.
Because the `setup_gnmi_server` is a `module` fixture it's done once for the entire `gnmi` module of tests.
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/gnmi/conftest.py#L38
So if we restrict these 2 tests to only run on a frontend node we're forcing all tests in the `gnmi` module to run on a frontend node and this could result in a loss of coverage (some tests can run on the supervisor)
